evidence_boundary: SW2-14 covers Incremental Project Truth Compiler only: deterministic fail-closed impact analysis, selective develop/verify regeneration, preservation of unchanged projections, unknown-impact escalation, and exhaustive finalize parity. It must not weaken accepted Project Truth authority, schema/toolchain identity, sequence evidence, exact-head acceptance, or any prior V2 guarantee.

requirements.evidence: NOT_PROVEN until the current full regeneration pipeline is mapped, impact edges are explicit/deterministic, and ambiguous or unsupported impact cannot silently narrow work.
requirements.requirement: Project Truth impact graph is deterministic, dependency-aware, and fail-closed.

requirements.evidence: NOT_PROVEN until selective regeneration is implemented with byte/digest evidence proving unaffected projections remain untouched.
requirements.requirement: Develop/verify regenerate only affected facts and projections and do not rewrite unchanged tracked projections.

requirements.evidence: NOT_PROVEN until adversarial negative paths prove unknown inputs and dependency gaps escalate fail-closed to a broader safe path.
requirements.requirement: Unknown or ambiguous impact broadens regeneration and validation rather than permitting a false PASS.

requirements.evidence: NOT_PROVEN until exhaustive finalize parity, exact-head cleanliness, Ubuntu/Windows governance, sequence evidence, engine performance, and real-consumer acceptance all pass on the final candidate.
requirements.requirement: Finalize remains exhaustive and produces governance-equivalent canonical outputs to the accepted full regeneration path across platforms and the permanent matrix.
